response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrated experience in agentic AI systems at scale, fintech infrastructure, or regulated financial environments, and has no evidence of leading engineering teams beyond 10 people or designing multi-agent frameworks with real-time market data integration — all core requirements for this CTO role.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background with diverse tech exposure
Active open-source contributions and technical communication skills
Experience with event-driven systems and distributed architectures
concerns: No proven production experience with multi-agent AI systems in fintech
Lacks leadership track record scaling teams to 30+ or governing hybrid engineering models
No demonstrated experience with financial compliance, credit risk, or real-time trading systems
